constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: refund_id comment: 所属退款单（→ refund） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: order_item_id comment: 订单商品（→ order_item） constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: quantity comment: 退款数量 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: refund_amount comment: 退款金额 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: user_account comment: 用户（外部） note: 来自登录注册模块 columns: - name: id comment: 用户ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: merchants comment: 商家（外部） note: 来自主数据模块，区分自营/三方 columns: - name: id comment: 商家ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: product comment: 实物商品（外部） note: 来自商品模块，一物一件 columns: - name: product_id comment: 商品ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: listing comment: 渠道上架（外部） note: 来自商品模块，渠道定价 columns: - name: listing_id comment: 上架ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: parent_order to: order type: 1:N label: 按商家拆单 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.8 - from: order to: order_item type: 1:N label: 包含商品 color: '#1565C0' penwidth: 1.8 - from: order to: order_package type: 1:N label: 发货包裹 color: '#E8833A' penwidth: 1.4 - from: order to: refund type: 1:N label: 发起退款 color: '#C0392B' penwidth: 1.4 - from: refund to: refund_item type: 1:N label: 包含商品 color: '#C0392B' penwidth: 1.4 - from: refund_item to: order_item type: N:1 label: 关联订单商品 color: '#C0392B' penwidth: 1.0 - from: parent_order to: user_account type: N:1 label: 买家 - from: order to: merchants type: N:1 label: 商家 - from: order_item to: product type: N:1 label: 实物商品 - from: order_item to: listing type: N:1 label: 渠道上架 design_rules: parent_order_split: 买家一次下单按商家拆单：1 parent_order → N order（每商家一单）。支付模块以 parent_order 为单位对接，payment_ref_no 引用支付模块单号 order_status_enum: order_status 枚举：pending_payment(待付款) / paid(已付款) / shipped(已发货) / completed(交易完成) / cancelled(已取消)。发货状态由 order_package.package_status 管理，不在 order 层细分 item_status_enum: item_status 枚举：pending(待发货) / refunding(退款中) / refunded(已退款) / shipped(已发货) / received(已签收) / cancelled(已取消) package_status_enum: package_status 枚举：pending(待发货) / shipped(已发货) / received(已签收) payment_status_enum: payment_status 枚举：pending(待支付) / paid(已支付) / failed(支付失败) refund_status_enum: refund_status 枚举：pending(待处理) / processing(处理中) / completed(已完成) / rejected(已拒绝) refund_type_enum: refund_type 枚举：pre_shipment(发货前退款)。后续扩展退货退款时新增类型 request_channel_enum: request_channel 枚举：email(邮件)。后续扩展自助申请时新增 app / web operator_type_enum: operator_type 枚举：admin(运营人员) / system(系统自动)。参考库存模块 inventory_ledger 的操作人设计模式 address_snapshot: 订单创建时快照收货地址（address_id UUID + 10 个快照字段）。字段命名对齐地址模块：address_line1/state_province/postal_code。recipient_first_name + last_name 拆分存储（报关需要），recipient_name 冗余拼接用于展示。地址模块后续更新不影响已有订单 price_snapshot: order_item 在创建时快照 listing_price 为 unit_price。listing 价格变动不影响已有订单 condition_snapshot: order_item 快照 product_inspection.grade 为 condition_grade package_boundary: 订单模块用 order_package 记录「发了几个包裹」，物流模块管「怎么发」（承运商/追踪/轨迹）。跨模块关联：order_no = shipments.business_order_no（按订单维度），tracking_no = shipments.tracking_no（按包裹维度）。物流模块是独立信息服务，不直接引用订单实体 order_completion_rule: 订单完成判定：所有 order_package.package_status 为 received → 订单标记 completed refund_blocks_shipping: 退款审批通过后，order_item.item_status 变为 refunding → 该商品不得发货 package_simplification: 订单 = 履约作业单元（按商家拆单，未来按仓库再拆）。多包裹仅因物理尺寸约束，不做包裹-商品映射。买家视角只关心「订单有几个包裹，追踪号是什么」 cart_to_order_flow: 购物车到订单数据流：cart_item.listing_id → listing.product_id + listing.listing_price → 创建 order_item（product_id + listing_id + 快照价格/成色） currency_rule: 同一订单内所有金额使用相同 currency_code。parent_order.total_amount = SUM(order.order_amount) user_id_redundancy: order.user_id 与 parent_order.user_id 冗余存储，避免查询「我的订单」时 join parent_order 表 merchant_id_vs_seller_id: 商品模块用 seller_id 引用 merchants.id（卖方语境），订单模块用 merchant_id 引用同一实体（商家语境）。同一 FK 目标，不同业务语义
